name: AI Audit and Assurance
description: A practitioner course in auditing AI: choosing criteria, building the AI audit universe, scoping risk-based engagements, testing governance and lifecycle controls, reperforming evaluations and inspecting LLM logs and guardrails, writing findings and reporting to the audit committee, and understanding regulated audits such as NYC bias audits and EU AI Act conformity assessment.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI Audit and Assurance

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 18 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 25 questions, 50 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
